notes: Added 5 stories covering schema, logic, API, UI, tests, and integration for specialty match transparency.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for specialty match transparency
Added core logic story for dual-pipeline attribution

EVAL-SC-S1.title: Define Specialty Match Transparency Schema and Contract
EVAL-SC-S1.description: Define response schema to expose matched_classifications including specialty label, NUCC code, confidence (if available), and pipeline origin (regex, vector, or both). Ensure contract supports multiple matches and deduplicated aggregation.

EVAL-SC-S2.title: Implement Dual-Pipeline Attribution Logic
EVAL-SC-S2.description: Extend specialty_service to tag each matched classification with its originating pipeline (regex, vector, or both), ensuring deduplication preserves provenance and aggregated classifications reflect combined signals.

EVAL-SC-S3.title: Expose Specialty Match Transparency via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-SC-S3.description: Update evaluate_care_facade (and/or find_care_facade where applicable) to include matched_classifications with pipeline attribution in API responses without breaking existing consumers.

EVAL-SC-S4.title: Render Specialty Match Transparency in UI
EVAL-SC-S4.description: Update frontend message rendering to display matched specialties and clearly indicate pipeline origin (e.g., 'Matched via exact term' vs 'Matched via semantic similarity'), ensuring readability within chat responses.

EVAL-SC-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Match Transparency
EVAL-SC-S5.description: Add unit tests for pipeline attribution and deduplication logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from specialty_service through facade to API response including correct pipeline labels.
EVAL-SC-S5.evidence: Code/.../specialty_service.py; backend/tests; existing test patterns (test_tool_router, test_embedding_client)
